name: focus-mode-firebase-tests
description: Focus Mode+ v22: Firestore Security Rules (incl. adversarial) and account-deletion tests against the Firebase Emulator Suite. Test tooling only; not part of the PWA (no build step there) or the Android app.

scripts.test:emulator: npx --yes firebase-tools@15.37.0 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-focus-mode "node --test --test-concurrency=1 test/*.test.cjs"
scripts.test:emulator:ci: mkdir -p test-results && npx --yes firebase-tools@15.37.0 emulators:exec --only firestore,auth --project demo-focus-mode "node --test --test-concurrency=1 --test-reporter=spec --test-reporter-destination=stdout --test-reporter=junit --test-reporter-destination=test-results/rules-junit.xml test/*.test.cjs"
